name: obsidian
description: Obsidian toolkit forked from kepano/obsidian-skills. Bundles five Agent Skills for Obsidian work — CLI automation of running vaults, Bases (database) authoring, JSON Canvas authoring, Obsidian-flavored Markdown editing, and Defuddle-powered web-to-Markdown conversion. The obsidian-cli skill additionally carries platform and troubleshooting references cherry-picked from the third-party Obsidian-CLI-skill project.
